sources.excerpt: Dual-Tone Published on February 17, 2006 Prescription Electronics distortion overdrive pedal Controls Vol Tone Rhythm Lead On/Off Rhythm/Lead Fat Information Prescription Electronics An overdrive/distortion pedal that never sounds small, thin or compressed. This unique pedal allows you to preset two different levels of gain. The switchable tone section fattens up your sound even when the pedal is plugged into a bright amp.
